scenes.name: 01-focus
scenes.zh: 想投几只股票，却不知道从哪看起？加入自选，打开信息导图。
scenes.en: Got a few stocks in mind? Add them to your watchlist. Open the Information Map.

en: Got a few stocks in mind?

scenes.name: 02-source
scenes.zh: 博主为什么看多？点到原话。习惯看K线？顺手就能看。
scenes.en: Why is a creator bullish? Jump to the exact quote. Prefer charts? They’re right here.

scenes.name: 03-pelosi
scenes.zh: 再看佩洛西披露：交易记录，直接连到原始文件。
scenes.en: Check Pelosi’s reported trades, then open the original filing.

scenes.name: 04-daily
scenes.zh: 每天相关消息，AI帮你梳理，留在你的投资时间线里。
scenes.en: AI pulls together what matters to your stocks. Your briefings build a daily investment timeline.

scenes.name: 05-oversold
scenes.zh: 每天检查超跌，设好提醒。再回放两个例子。
scenes.en: Find oversold stocks. Set alerts. Now, replay two examples.

scenes.name: 06-hood
scenes.zh: 罗宾汉董事买入披露后，二十个交易日涨了四成。
scenes.en: Robinhood: a director’s purchase filing, then a rise of about forty-one percent over twenty sessions.

scenes.name: 07-nokia
scenes.zh: 诺基亚合作消息后，回落到五块八毛七，后来到十块零三。
scenes.en: Nokia: a partnership announcement, a pullback to five eighty-seven, then ten oh-three.

scenes.name: 08-start
scenes.zh: 少翻消息，把时间留给自己。Ducky，免费关注一只。
scenes.en: Less scrolling. More time for you. Start free with Ducky.
